mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_manual_adjustment (id, adjustment_no, ledger_book_id, accounting_period_id, currency, reason_code, file_id, file_content_hash, total_debit, total_credit, content_hash, submitted_time, status, maker_id, version, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{id}, #{adjustmentNo}, #{ledgerBookId}, #{accountingPeriodId}, #{currency}, #{reasonCode}, #{fileId}, #{fileContentHash}, #{totalDebit}, #{totalCredit}, #{contentHash}, #{submittedTime}, #{status}, #{makerId}, #{version}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, adjustment_no, ledger_book_id, accounting_period_id, currency, reason_code, file_id, file_content_hash, total_debit, total_credit, content_hash, submitted_time, status, maker_id, version, create_time, update_time FROM t_manual_adjustment WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT m.id manual_adjustment_id, m.adjustment_no, m.ledger_book_id, m.accounting_period_id, m.currency, m.reason_code, m.status, m.total_debit, m.total_credit, m.maker_id, m.submitted_time, e.id journal_entry_id FROM t_manual_adjustment m LEFT JOIN t_accounting_instruction i ON i.manual_adjustment_id = m.id LEFT JOIN t_journal_entry e ON e.instruction_id = i.id AND e.ledger_book_id = m.ledger_book_id
ORDER BY m.submitted_time DESC, m.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.update: UPDATE t_manual_adjustment SET status = #{status}, version = version + 1, update_time = #{now} WHERE id = #{adjustment.id} AND status = #{adjustment.status} AND version = #{adjustment.version}
